## File: find-results-menu.yaml
## Type: project menu
## Purpose: Menu for search results actions and panes (results list,
## preview pane, diff finder). Used by search and navigation workflows.

metadata:
  udi: prismata.universe.menu.find.results
  name: "Find Results Menu"
  version: "0.1.0"
  kind: menu
  description: "Submenu for search result actions and pane views."

udi: "prismata.universe.menu.find.results"
kind: menu
type: "menu"
title: "Search Results"
header:
  type: "search_params"

items:
  - key: "1"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.find.results.results-list"
    label: "Results List"
    description: "Display the current search result set in ranked order."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-search-results"
    ui_framework: pane
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "2"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.find.results.preview-pane"
    label: "Preview Pane"
    description: "Show the active object preview and metadata summary."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-exemplar-preview"
    ui_framework: pane
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "3"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.find.results.version-carousel"
    label: "Version Carousel"
    description: "Page through compatible versions of the active result."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-search-results"
    ui_framework: multi_pane
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "4"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.find.results.diff-finder"
    label: "Diff Finder"
    description: "Compare semantic fields and normalized values across matches."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-diff-compatible"
    ui_framework: diff_view
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "5"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.find.results.refresh-results"
    label: "Refresh Results"
    description: "Re-run the current find operation and refresh pane output."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.fs-search-execute"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null
